tagline: Test it. Fix it. Hand it over.
brief: A hardware diagnostics tool for Windows, for technicians who refurbish laptops. It should feel precise, modern and technical, away from medical imagery and Windows blue.
criteria: Success: readable at 16 px in the taskbar, works in one colour, no clichés (gears, magnifying glasses, stethoscopes, Windows logos).

concepts.name: Keycap W
concepts.idea: A keycap with a W: the keyboard test that opens the website, turned into the mark.
rationale: Recognisable at 16 px on dark and light taskbars
Cyan on Carbon: clear of the category's blues, oranges and greens
A thicker bottom lip makes it a key, without drawing a keyboard

recommendation: Keycap W — the approved, refined direction.
next_steps: Test the icon in the Windows taskbar at 100 % and 150 % scaling
Status colours for the app (passed, failed, attention)
